limitations: No fresh Linux/macOS, full CI matrix, live Copilot/Claude Code/VS Code, or PowerShell 7 qualification.
No post-remediation performance benchmark; prior measurements remain historical.
SDK routing is cooperative; no OS sandbox or protection against same-privilege key/config modification.
Plugin permissions are unsigned host prompts, distinct from SDK signed approvals; defer may not prompt.
Ledger is not externally anchored; full rewrite, tail truncation and consumed-token-history removal remain risks.
Linter exemptions and canonical-label gaps remain; a score is not a certification.
pytest 9.2.0 failed before collection on Python 3.10.0; successful run used pytest 8.4.2.
Fetched pages are vendor/publisher claims; title/body mismatches and empty retrievals are explicitly disclosed.
No signed configuration verification, CAC, general DLP, judicial/fairness detector or fallback engine implemented.
